patient_overview.name: Harris Schuster
patient_overview.description: Harris Schuster is a 58-year-old man from Deptford, New Jersey who works part-time doing light maintenance work and comes in for a nutrition visit tied to his blood pressure and a recent finding on heart imaging. He has lived with chronic back, neck, and general pain since 2014 and takes it as just part of getting older. He's polite but closed off, answering with 'whatever you think is best' when pushed on diet changes, and gives the impression he's humoring the visit more than engaging with it. He grazes on snacks all day instead of sitting down to meals, and a student will need patience and curiosity to find out what's really going on with his eating and what else he's taking beyond his prescriptions.

demographics.occupation: Part-time maintenance worker for a local property management company
demographics.cultural_context: Harris grew up in a working-class South Jersey family where you went to work, didn't complain, and didn't bother doctors unless something was broken or bleeding. He left school early to help his father with odd jobs, and he still measures a man's worth by whether he can show up and do the work, not by what his lab numbers say. Asking for help, including dietary help, doesn't sit easily with him.
